title: application-empty-error-states v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf with the eight-state probe pack and sample-app fixture
summary: T-1 shelf-blueprint track of the ratified visual round 4 (spec 2026-09-06, section 5.1): the application-empty-error-states v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf. Ships 19 contributions (5 REQs on state catalogue and recovery-action contract and announcement contract and least-privilege 5xx and 403 posture and offline write-buffer; 8 USs 22101-22108 binding runtime-observable ACs one per named state; 3 TACs 2301 state-machine and 2302 recovery-router and 2303 offline write-buffer; 3 ADRs 2301 HTTP status contract RFC 9110 and 2302 stack-trace visibility elicited and 2303 offline strategy elicited), a Playwright probe pack whose eight checks (AC-22101-1 through AC-22108-1) each anchor one named state via TAC-2301 or the operator-configured error-shell path glob with URLs composed by withUrl(runtimeUrl, path), and a dependency-free sample-app fixture at packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/probe-pack-application-empty-error-states/ serving all eight states honestly on /probe/<name> plus break switches (?break=stack-trace, ?break=leak-id, ?break=no-recovery, ?break=no-live-region) driving the negative runs. suggestedCompanions logging and errorHandling; providesRoles absent; requiresAppliedCapabilities absent (no auth required); capabilities absent. Sixth shipped consumer of T-0s probe-pack runner extension; T-3 forms-wizard and T-4 account-settings consume this blueprint.
